name: two-files
description: Edit two separate files. The better arm can batch both files in one multi-file edit call; the builtin edit tool is single-path, so it needs two calls. The prompt is arm-neutral: either strategy is a valid completion, and final tree scoring is identical for both.
prompt: Edit both files: bump VERSION_A to "0.2.0" in src/a.ts and VERSION_B to "0.2.0" in src/b.ts. Read both files first, then edit them — use whatever number of edit calls your tool requires (one batched call if it supports multiple files, otherwise one call per file). Use ONLY the read and edit tools.
